title: Gorgeous Riverfront Executive Home
description:
Come get away to this gorgeous, Riverfront retreat!  Fish from the backyard, or watch the sunset from the lawn with a glass of wine! Whether its a family getaway, working in town for a few weeks and desire the luxuries of home, or wanting to enjoy everything that Nashville has to offer, this is the perfect home!  Incredible location!  Walking distance to Grand ol Opry, restaurants, and the famous Nashville Palace! 10 minute uber to airport, and 15 to Downtown & Broadway.

The space
Spacious 5 bedroom, 4 bathroom home.  Media room with 80 inch TV and a baby grand piano. Backyard is flat lawn, and steep steps down to the river.

Other things to note
Peaceful setting on a quiet Road, but walking distance to Grand Ol Opery, restaurants, Nashville Palace, and renowned Opera Mills Mall.
